title: disappointed, hidden charges and app quality has gone downhill
content: This app has become a money grab. I have used this app for a long time, but the current version is extremely disappointing. The biggest issue is the subscription trap. I signed up for a trial expecting a trial experience, but I was charged afterward without a clear enough reminder. I have reported this to Apple because this kind of payment experience is not acceptable. What makes it worse is that the app itself is getting worse every year. The workouts are outdated, repetitive, and lack creativity. It feels like the team is recycling old content instead of creating new and useful fitness programs. For a paid fitness app, the lack of fresh content is unacceptable. I also noticed that critical reviews disappear, which makes me question how much the company values honest user feedback. This app used to have potential, but now it feels like the priority is getting subscriptions rather than delivering a quality fitness experience. Save your money and look for a better fitness app.
